alex: quick ask — can someone grab a short nsys capture for the small-batch latency regression? seeing 15-25% tail increase on dedicated.
maria: I can take it tonight on p4d-2. which exact workload + config?
alex: bench script: `benchmarks/latency_small_batch.py` use `--model redwood/ggml-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --repeat 50`.
chris: add NVTX ranges around the inference loop please, otherwise flamegraphs are noisy. we use `NVTX_PUSH("inference_loop")` in C++ runtimes.
maria: ok. plan: nsys record for 45s, nvtx regions, also run a 1-iter torch.profiler capture for op-level breakdown and a folded stack for flamegraph.
alex: exact commands I typically use:
```
# nsys
nsys profile --output=nsys_capture -t cuda,osrt,cuda_mem --capture-range=nvtx --wait=ms --force-overwrite --sample=cpu --python "python benchmarks/latency_small_batch.py --model redwood/ggml-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --repeat 50"

# torch profiler (kineto)
python -u -m torch.profiler --schedule="(1,1)" --export-to=kineto.json -c "python benchmarks/latency_small_batch.py --model redwood/ggml-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --repeat 1"
```
maria: thanks — I'll gzip the nsys output and upload both to the profiling bucket: `gs://redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/1802506789/` and post links here.
chris: when you upload, include the `metadata.txt` with kernel/driver versions, CUDA, cuDNN, container hash, and whether KV cache was enabled. also note quantization/precision and if we disabled prefetch.
maria: added note: KV cache = enabled, quant = int8, driver = 535.112, CUDA = 12.2. container = sha256:abc123 (will put in metadata).
alex: perfect. if you can, also capture `--nvprof` style CPU stacks for the 1st warmup iter so we can compare kernel startup vs steady-state.
maria: will do. expected upload in ~45m.
ci-bot: build/test pipeline succeeded for bench change (job #4821) :white_check_mark:
chris: once uploaded I'll run the flamegraph generation locally (collapse-stacks -> flamegraph.pl) and post a screenshot + folded stacks. also check for excessive memcpy or kernel serialization.
alex: thanks team. tagging @maria for follow-up — if anything looks off ping me. :thumbsup:
maria: uploaded: https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/1802506789/ — files: nsys_capture.nsys, nsys_capture.qdrep.gz, kineto.json.gz, metadata.txt
chris: got it, starting analysis. will post quick notes when I see hotspots.
alex: adding if anyone else runs this: disable background devtools (chrome) on the host; they can add noise to cpu sample rates.
maria: noted. thanks!
